sentences.cn_text: 如果工会领袖吉米·霍法今天仍然在世，他或许会去代表公务员群体。
sentences.en_text: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants.

sentences.cn_text: 1960年霍法领导的卡车司机工会处于鼎盛时期时，美国政府雇员中仅有十分之一加入工会；而如今这一比例已达36%。
sentences.en_text: When Hoffa’s Teamsters were in their prime in 1960, only one in ten American government workers belonged to a union; now 36% do.

sentences.cn_text: 2009年，美国公共部门的工会会员人数超过了私营部门的同行人数。
sentences.en_text: In 2009 the number of unionists in America’s public sector passed that of their fellow members in the private sector.

sentences.cn_text: 在英国，超过半数的公共部门雇员加入了工会，而私营部门的入会比例仅约为15%。
sentences.en_text: In Britain, more than half of public-sector workers but only about 15% of private-sector ones are unionized.

sentences.cn_text: 公共部门工会兴旺发达的原因有三。
sentences.en_text: There are three reasons for the public-sector unions’ thriving.

sentences.cn_text: 首先，他们可以采取停工行动而无需承担多少后果。
sentences.en_text: First, they can shut things down without suffering much in the way of consequences.

sentences.cn_text: 其次，他们大多聪明且受教育程度较高。
sentences.en_text: Second, they are mostly bright and well-educated.

sentences.cn_text: 四分之一的美国公共部门雇员拥有大学学位。
sentences.en_text: A quarter of America’s public-sector workers have a university degree.

sentences.cn_text: 第三，他们如今在中左翼政治中占据主导地位。
sentences.en_text: Third, they now dominate left-of-centre politics.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的某些联系可以追溯到很久以前。
sentences.en_text: Some of their ties go back a long way.

sentences.cn_text: 英国工党，顾名思义，长期以来与工会主义保持着密切联系。
sentences.en_text: Britain’s Labor Party, as its name implies, has long been associated with trade unionism.

sentences.cn_text: 该党现任领导人埃德·米利班德的当选有赖于公共部门工会的投票支持。
sentences.en_text: Its current leader, Ed Miliband, owes his position to votes from public-sector unions.

sentences.cn_text: 在州一级，他们的影响力甚至更加令人畏惧。
sentences.en_text: At the state level their influence can be even more fearsome.

sentences.cn_text: 加州公共政策研究所的马克·巴尔达萨雷指出，该州预算的很大一部分受到工会的监控。
sentences.en_text: Mark Baldassare of the Public Policy Institute of California points out that much of the state’s budget is patrolled by unions.

sentences.cn_text: 教师工会监督学校系统，加州惩教和平官员协会监督监狱系统，而各类劳工组织则监督医疗保健领域。
sentences.en_text: The teachers’ unions keep an eye on schools, the CCPOA on prisons and a variety of labor groups on health care.

sentences.cn_text: 在许多富裕国家，公共部门的平均工资高于私营部门。
sentences.en_text: In many rich countries average wages in the state sector are higher than in the private one.

sentences.cn_text: 但真正的收益体现在福利待遇和工作安排方面。
sentences.en_text: But the real gains come in benefits and work practices.

sentences.cn_text: 政治家们反复采用「后置加载」的方式处理公共部门薪酬协议，将工资增长幅度控制在适度水平，但增加假期，尤其是增加本已十分优厚的养老金。
sentences.en_text: Politicians have repeatedly “backloaded” public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous.

sentences.cn_text: 改革遭到了强烈抵制，其中以教育领域最为典型，特许学校、学院制学校以及绩效工资制度都经历了旷日持久的抗争。
sentences.en_text: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most notoriously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管有大量证据表明教师素质是最重要的影响因素，教师工会却一直反对淘汰不合格教师和提拔优秀教师的做法。
sentences.en_text: Even though there is plenty of evidence that the quality of the teachers is the most important variable, teachers’ unions have fought against getting rid of bad ones and promoting good ones.

sentences.cn_text: 随着这一制度给其他人造成的成本日益显现，政治家们开始采取严厉措施。
sentences.en_text: As the cost to everyone else has become clearer, politicians have begun to clamp down.

sentences.cn_text: 在威斯康星州,工会组织了数千名支持者反对强硬派共和党州长斯科特·沃克。
sentences.en_text: In Wisconsin the unions have rallied thousands of supporters against Scott Walker, the hardline Republican governor.

sentences.cn_text: 但公共部门内部也有许多人在现行制度下深受其害。
sentences.en_text: But many within the public sector suffer under the current system, too.

sentences.cn_text: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员系统中的文化规范适合那些安于现状的人，却不利于高成就者的发展。
sentences.en_text: John Donahue at Harvard’s Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but is bad for high achievers.

sentences.cn_text: 美国公共部门年收入远超25万美元的雇员只有大学体育教练和美国总统。
sentences.en_text: The only American public-sector workers who earn well above $250,sss000 a year are university sports coaches and the president of the United States.

sentences.cn_text: 银行家的高薪酬包引发了大量批评，但一个不奖励高成就者的公共部门体系对美国而言可能是一个更严重的问题。
sentences.en_text: Bankers’ fat pay packets have attracted much criticism, but a public-sector system that does not reward high achievers may be a much bigger problem for America.

sentences.cn_text: 从第一段可以得知____。
sentences.en_text: It can be learned from the first paragraph that ____

sentences.cn_text: 卡车司机工会仍拥有大量成员。
sentences.en_text: Teamsters still have a large body of members.

sentences.cn_text: 吉米·霍法曾担任公务员。
sentences.en_text: Jimmy Hoffa used to work as a civil servant.

sentences.cn_text: 工会扩大了其公共部门的会员规模。
sentences.en_text: unions have enlarged their public-sector membership.

sentences.cn_text: 政府改善了与工会会员的关系。
sentences.en_text: the government has improved its relationship with unionists.

sentences.cn_text: 关于第二段，下列哪项表述正确？
sentences.en_text: Which of the following is true of Paragraph 2?

sentences.cn_text: 公共部门工会在采取行动时较为谨慎。
sentences.en_text: Public-sector unions are prudent in taking actions.

sentences.cn_text: 加入公共部门工会需要一定的教育背景。
sentences.en_text: Education is required for public-sector union membership.

sentences.cn_text: 工党长期以来一直在与公共部门工会对抗。
sentences.en_text: Labor Party has long been fighting against public-sector unions.

sentences.cn_text: 公共部门工会很少因其行动而陷入困境。
sentences.en_text: Public-sector unions seldom get in trouble for their actions.

sentences.cn_text: 从第四段可以得知，公共部门的收入是____。
sentences.en_text: It can be learned from Paragraph 4 that the income in the state sector is ____

sentences.cn_text: 通过非法手段获得的。
sentences.en_text: illegally secured.

sentences.cn_text: 间接增加的。
sentences.en_text: indirectly augmented.

sentences.cn_text: 过度增长的。
sentences.en_text: excessively increased.

sentences.cn_text: 经过合理调整的。
sentences.en_text: fairly adjusted.

sentences.cn_text: 威斯康星州工会的例子表明工会____。
sentences.en_text: The example of the unions in Wisconsin shows that unions ____

sentences.cn_text: 经常与现行政治体制相抵触。
sentences.en_text: often run against the current political system.

sentences.cn_text: 能够改变人们的政治态度。
sentences.en_text: can change people’s political attitudes.

sentences.cn_text: 可能成为公共部门改革的阻碍。
sentences.en_text: may be a barrier to public-sector reforms.

sentences.cn_text: 在政府中处于主导地位。
sentences.en_text: are dominant in the government.

sentences.cn_text: 约翰·多纳休对公共部门体系的态度是____。
sentences.en_text: John Donahue’s attitude towards the public-sector system is one of ____

sentences.cn_text: 不赞同。
sentences.en_text: disapproval.

sentences.cn_text: 赞赏。
sentences.en_text: appreciation.

sentences.cn_text: 容忍。
sentences.en_text: tolerance.

sentences.cn_text: 漠不关心。
sentences.en_text: indifference.
